Patient Factors: **Demographics**;Older age, especially >75 y;Obesity;Women > men;More common in Blacks;Excess dietary sodium;High baseline BP and chronicity of uncontrolled hypertension
Secondary Causes of Resistant Hypertensi: **Common causes**;Primary hyperaldosteronism (Conn adenoma);Atherosclerotic renovascular disease;Sleep apnea;CKD
Concomitant Medications That May Raise B: **Prescription**;Oral contraceptives;NSAIDs;Sympathomimetics (e.g., decongestants in cold remedies);Cyclosporine;Erythropoietin;Corticosteroids (e.g., prednisone, hydrocortisone)
Causes of "Pseudoresistant Hypertension": **Poor patient adherence to medications**;Check BP response to directly observed medication
